title: Predictive Simulations Settings Carbs ratio page is the same like Insulin sensitivity
symptom: During setup of predictive simulation settings, the page for Carbs ratio appears the same as insulin sensitivity, preventing entry of expected values like 2.5 units for 12g carbohydrates.
evidence_quote: The page for Carbs ratio page is the same like insulin sensitivity, so i can't enter the values i expect like, 2,5 units for 12g carbo hydrates.
